description: This file defines the SiloAddress class which encapsulates the details of silo addresses in Orleans, including creation, parsing, serialization, hashing, and comparison logic.

classes.name: SiloAddress
classes.description: A data class representing a silo address, including methods for creation, parsing, serialization, hashing, and comparison.

classes.name: SiloAddressConverter
classes.description: JSON converter for serializing and deserializing SiloAddress instances.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Factory method to create a new SiloAddress from an IPEndPoint or IPAddress, with interning and normalization.

methods.name: AllocateNewGeneration
methods.description: Allocates a new silo generation number based on current time and last generation.

methods.name: ToParsableString
methods.description: Returns a string suitable for parsing back into a SiloAddress, including address, port, and generation.

methods.name: FromParsableString
methods.description: Creates a SiloAddress from a string produced by ToParsableString.

methods.name: ToUtf8String
methods.description: Returns a UTF8 byte array representation of the SiloAddress.

methods.name: FromUtf8String
methods.description: Parses a SiloAddress from a UTF8 byte span.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the endpoint and generation.

methods.name: GetConsistentHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code suitable for consistent hashing applications.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this SiloAddress to another, primarily by generation, then port, then IP address.
